caption: The drawing features a garment accessory that appears to be a shawl or capelet, depicted in black ink on an off-white or beige background. The object consists of two main sections: an upper, shorter decorative band and a larger, V-shaped lower section. The upper band has a lace-like edge with a scalloped pattern and is filled with intricate, repetitive lines suggesting texture. The lower V-shaped section is bordered by a wide, fringe-like trim, with closely spaced parallel lines indicating fullness or thickness. Two thin, straight lines extend diagonally from the top corners of the lower section to the upper section, connecting the pieces and adding structure to the composition, which is centrally placed and occupies the upper central part of the otherwise blank paper.
title: Cape
